components.name: Artwork caption
components.html:
The homelab garden

A little room for servers, experiments, and the satisfaction of getting things to work.

narrative.overview: Original architectural miniatures lead; interface chrome stays flat and quietly precise. The palette is fully committed at page scale, with lavender exhibition ground, mint about passage and peach contact close. Artwork is lit three-dimensional geometry, not interface boxes pretending to be illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Collectible ceramic geometry and small crafted objects.
Rounded sans lettering with open, readable body copy.
Reversible manual inspection, no free-roam or idle loop.

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: Color owns regions, not isolated decorative accents.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Artwork captions stay independently legible and disclose imagined content plainly.

dos: Do let original artwork carry depth and craft.
Do keep meaningful personal information directly reachable.
Do keep disclosures next to illustrative work.
donts: Don't borrow Peter's images, characters or models.
Don't describe imagined scenes as completed work or client proof.
Don't add free-roam or require game completion to contact Victor.
